cards.verse_text: So Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him.
cards.snippet: …give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him.

cards.card_text: Ezra tells them to make a confession to the LORD, do His will, and ___ themselves from the people of the land and from their foreign wives.
cards.verse_text: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will.
cards.snippet: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will.

cards.card_text: They stand in their places and read from the Book of the Law for a quarter of the day, then spend another quarter in confession and worship.
cards.verse_text: While they stood in their places, they read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and they spent another quarter of the day in confession and worship of the LORD their God.
cards.snippet: …of the day, and they spent another quarter of the day in confession and worship of the LORD their God.

cards.verse_text: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD.
cards.snippet: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD.

cards.card_text: Paul reminds Timothy when that call came: when he made the good confession.
cards.verse_text: Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
cards.snippet: …eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.

cards.card_text: Timothy made his good confession in private, with no one else around.
cards.verse_text: Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
cards.snippet: …eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.

cards.card_text: Paul says Christ Jesus made the good confession too.
cards.verse_text: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
cards.snippet: …life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:

cards.card_text: And look at that: "the good confession" again, the same words Paul just used for Timothy.
